{{Top|leg}}
A '''sensory deprivation containment device''' was a coffin-like box with a narrow slit in the top. A being placed inside of the box would not be able to see or hear anything. Around [[47 BBY/Legends|47 BBY]], it was used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[New Apsolon/Legends|Apsolon]] by the [[Absolutes]] to torture prisoners. When the Absolutes were removed from power, all but one of the devices were destroyed, with the last one being placed in a museum. [[41 BBY/Legends|Six years later]], in a bid to return to power, the Absolutes stole the device, captured the twins [[Eritha]] and [[Alani]], and placed them inside while demanding that [[Supreme Governor]] [[Roan]] resign. Soon after, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tahl]] was captured and held in the sensory deprivation containment device for several days, which, combined with the injection of a paralytic drug, led to her [[Death/Legends|death]].
